audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 all read Quinn or Skill while their own whys said 'you out-stat a level-1 marksman', 'even early skirmish', 'you out-duel her at 3' and '6 flips back to you'.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Quinn, Warwick, Quinn, Quinn] at 56.42%, which is exactly what the whys describe: you own melee range until her lethality item, she owns 4-5 and everything after her first item.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 4 to Warwick and row 1 to Skill as matched pairs with ratings; her rows 3, 5, 6 untouched.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered around her lethality item and her roam ultimate. Blinding Assault's 11s and Vault's 12-8s were the missing detail, not the structure.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns added to the early and level-6 spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings said Infinite Duress 'ignores Vault' and 'channels through her blind'.
audit.why: Riot's own Vault text says she leaps off the target, 'briefly interrupting it' — and Infinite Duress is flagged interruptible, so Vault stops your ultimate rather than being ignored by it. The blind half is right for the wrong reason: Blinding Assault suppresses basic attacks, so it hurts Eternal Hunger procs, not the suppression.
audit.corrected: Reversed the interaction: spend her Vault first, then ult. Also removed the fabricated Warwick 'Q reset' from the early text.

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Quinn's Vault is down.
edits.after: Blood Hunt only turns on below 50% health, so level 2 is even — respect the 11s Blinding Assault.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Quinn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Jaws plus Primal Howl beats a marksman in melee, so hold the wave near you and make her walk up to it.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Quinn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and her blind does not stop it, but Vault interrupts the leap — spend her E first, then commit everything.

edits.before: Infinite Duress channels through her blind and ignores Vault, so 6 flips back to you.
edits.after: Infinite Duress beats her blind, but Vault interrupts it — ult after her E and 6 is yours.

edits.before: Infinite Duress ignores her Vault knockback and her E's dash-away; ult her the instant she blinds you and you win the all-in outright.
edits.after: Blinding Assault greys out your autos, never Infinite Duress — but Vault (12-8s) interrupts the leap, so ult only once she has spent her E.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay yours until she blinks in items: your E cancels her Vault engage and Q keeps you topped, and at 6 Infinite Duress channels through her blind to lock her down. Bait the Vault, then commit.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay yours until she buys items: Primal Howl's fear answers her step-up and Jaws keeps you topped, and at 6 the suppression beats her blind. Bait Vault first — it interrupts your leap.

edits.before: Level 1-2 you out-stat her — she's a marksman with no early sustain, so hug the wave and punish any auto with a Q reset. Her only trade tool is Blinding Assault (Q), which greys out your autos but not your ability damage.
edits.after: Level 1-2 you out-stat her — a marksman with no early sustain — so hug the wave and punish every auto with Jaws. Her trade tool is Blinding Assault (Q, 11s), which greys out your autos but not your ability damage.

edits.before: Use E Primal Howl to eat her Blinding Assault windup
edits.after: Use Primal Howl's 2.5s damage reduction on her burst

edits.before: Q-bite Quinn as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Quinn the instant Vault is on cooldown, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

edits.before: Q-bite Quinn as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Quinn the instant Vault is on cooldown, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

notes: Packet flagged 'Blinding Assault' in whys[3] as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE, it is her real Q and the sentence is fine. Chart conflict: the mirror set rows 3 and 5 to Skill and row 6 to Warwick, which disagrees with our packet chart and with this page's own whys; I followed packet plus internal consistency and flagged it. Whether Vault's interrupt or a Cleanse beats an Infinite Duress already applied is not answerable from the kits and was left unstated. Full layer calls Quinn 'he' in several inherited strings. Brief games=334 vs packet games=179.
